preconditions.description: The number of blocks in t and s must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l_i <= 1000000 for l_i in t_lengths) and all(1 <= l_i <= 1000000 for l_i in s_lengths)
preconditions.description: The length of each block in t and s must be between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c_i.islower() for c_i in t_chars) and all(c_i.islower() for c_i in s_chars)
preconditions.description: Each character in t and s must be a lowercase English letter.

postconditions.description: The output is the number of occurrences of s in t.
